---
title: "Verify Release"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

Release verification is an explicit operator step after the target graph has
completed. Run these checks inside the supported container and retain their
output with the release record.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm Pipeline Completion"}

Confirm that `targets::tar_make()` completed and that
`data/outputs/releases/v0.1.0/datapackage.json` exists.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Validate The Frictionless Release"}

```r
release_directory_chr <- file.path(
  "data", "outputs", "releases", "v0.1.0"
)
release_package_list <- frictionless::read_package(
  file.path(release_directory_chr, "datapackage.json")
)

stopifnot(
  setequal(
    frictionless::resource_names(release_package_list),
    c("biomarker_ptx", "demog_ptx")
  )
)

biomarker_release_df <- frictionless::read_resource(
  release_package_list,
  "biomarker_ptx"
)
demog_release_df <- frictionless::read_resource(
  release_package_list,
  "demog_ptx"
)

stopifnot(
  !any(c("community", "island") %in% names(biomarker_release_df)),
  !any(c("community", "island") %in% names(demog_release_df))
)

schema_description_complete <- function(package_list, resource_name_chr) {
  resource_schema_list <- frictionless::schema(
    package_list,
    resource_name_chr
  )
  all(vapply(
    resource_schema_list$fields,
    function(field_list) {
      !is.null(field_list$description) && nzchar(field_list$description)
    },
    logical(1)
  ))
}

stopifnot(
  schema_description_complete(release_package_list, "biomarker_ptx"),
  schema_description_complete(release_package_list, "demog_ptx")
)

stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  biomarker_release_df,
  targets::tar_read(biomarker_ptx_clinical_participant_curated_df),
  check.attributes = FALSE
)))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  demog_release_df,
  targets::tar_read(demog_ptx_location_participant_curated_df),
  check.attributes = FALSE
)))
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Confirm Pipeline Stability"}

Run `targets::tar_make()` a second time without changing inputs or code. It
should perform no target work. Then inspect `targets::tar_manifest()` and the
generated graph to confirm that no `slimmed_*`, `small_*`, `curation_*`, or
generic writer targets remain.

:::
